purpose: Close the remaining pre-body X1 source gap by freezing an official outcome-blind point-in-time Binance USD-M contract listing/delisting identity procedure and metadata-only qualification implementation. No prices, returns, correlations or market bodies may be opened.

fixed_constraints.node_reserve_rule: last ceil(N/4) in frozen hash order

requirements: Identify one exact official/public metadata lineage that can mechanically establish original contract identity, listing epoch and delisting/termination state/time for USD-M perpetual contracts before cutoff. Public documentation lookup is allowed; market-price/body access is not.

Do not infer listing/delisting solely from realized prices, volume, correlation or current surviving symbols. Archive first/last month may be used only as source-coverage metadata, not instrument-identity truth.
Freeze contract_identity = venue + market type + original instrument identity + listing epoch + denomination/multiplier version, including renames/redenominations/relistings.
Preserve X1-002 exclusion rules for non-USDT settlement, dated contracts, leveraged/index-basket tokens, stablecoin-underlying contracts and ambiguous mappings.

Implement or specify one deterministic metadata-only resolver that can later build the retrospective pool, hash-order it with SC001-X1-ATLAS-v0.1, reserve NODE_RESERVE and produce month-level PIT membership without price access.
Freeze exact one-shot T1 source request/byte budget. Execute none here.

If no sufficiently official PIT metadata lineage can be established without semantic ambiguity, return X1_PIT_UNIVERSE_SOURCE_STRATEGY_ATTENTION_REQUIRED rather than substituting current exchangeInfo, price history or heuristic listing dates.
Do not execute X1-003 or any correlation/lead-lag calculation.
terminal_rule: Persist result/implementation/tests as applicable, verify/revalidate main, create Worker Result Manifest LAST, then one TERMINAL RECEIPT with CONTINUATION_REVIEW_REQUIRED: true and STRATEGY_REVIEW_REQUIRED: true. Stop.
allowed_pr_writes: worker progress comments only when required by canonical worker instructions
